defect_confirmed: overall_status could be INCOMPLETE while the process exited 0 and the workflow omitted --strict-release, so a green check was not release PASS.
implementation: three named gates: diagnostic, offline-release-gate, runtime-certification-gate
a gate is PASS only when every required section is PASS
FAIL/INCOMPLETE/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/WAIVED are all non-passes; blocking sections are named
offline CI does not require runtime certification; the runtime gate cannot pass on NOT_RUN
--gate authoritative; legacy exit contract preserved when omitted

status_truth_table.offline_PASS + runtime_NOT_RUN: offline gate PASS/exit 0; runtime gate INCOMPLETE/exit 1

title: Correct CI status semantics
